'''İbrahim Adnan Saraçoğlu''' (1949, [[Mersin]]) is a Turkish [[chemistry]] professor, [[biochemist]], [[microbiologist]] and researcher.

After his chemistry studies, he completed his PhD studies at the [[Karl-Franzens University]] and became an assistant at the Institute for Molecular Biosciences. Between 1985 and 1986, he worked at the [[Çukurova University]] and made his doctorate in 1987. In 1994, he became a professor.

He was a lecturer at the [[Karl-Franzens University]] and also was researcher/academic manager at the Institute for Physics and Biomedical Sensors of the AVL List.<ref>{{cite web
 | url        = http://www.merakname.com/ibrahim-adnan-saracoglu-kimdir/ibrahim-saracoglu/
 | author     = Hasan Arıkan
 | title      = İbrahim Adnan Saraçoğlu kimdir?
 | language   = Turkish
 | publisher  = Meraknâme
 | accessdate = 2014-02-01
}}</ref>

Saraçoğlu worked at the [[Technische Universität Wien|Vienna Technical University]] as a professor. He is the author of a number of articles in international scientific publications and owns a number of patents. Currently, he continues his research on botany and the influence of plants on human health focusing on the field of phytho-biochemistry.

Through his research, he concluded the healing effect of broccoli against prostatitis and benign prostata enlargement<ref>{{cite web
 | url        = http://www.krebsforum.at/index.php?topic=56.0
 | title      = Thema: Brokkoli-Kur nach Prof. İbrahim Adnan Saraçoğlu
 | language   = Turkish
 | date       = 2007-03-24
 | publisher  = 1. Österreichisches Krebsforum
 | accessdate = 2014-02-01
}}</ref> and the healing effect of [[lavender]] against [[hepatitis B]] and [[hepatitis C]]. He was the first to coin the term of "Preventive Vegetal Therapy" and built/stated its principles.<ref>{{cite web
 | url        = http://www.uzmantv.com/uzman/bitkisel-tedavi-uzmani-prof.-dr.-ibrahim-adnan-saracoglu
 | title      = Bitkisel Tedavi Uzmanı: Prof. Dr. İbrahim Adnan Saraçoğlu
 | language   = Turkish
 | date       = 2007-03-24
 | publisher  = Uzman TV
 | accessdate = 2014-02-01
}}</ref>
